results.note: Asserts required_bars >= 200 for all 4 OBV registry entries; registry.yaml confirms required_bars: 200 for btc_obv/eth_obv/sol_obv/bnb_obv.

Test reads definition.note via load_registry() (parsed model), not a hardcoded string; registry.py:62 defines note: NonEmptyString | None on IndicatorDefinition, and each OBV entry in registry.yaml carries the 'cumulative ... daily bars' reasoning next to required_bars.

Computes obv() over the full declared window vs the last 5 bars of a monotonically-increasing-close series and asserts the declared-window value is at least 10x the 5-bar value, proving the window materially affects output (load-bearing, not nominal).

Formula correctness is verified separately against the unmodified 5-bar hand-computed golden (obv_base_volume.json), distinct from the window-length tests above; the story's note explicitly forbids changing the golden to match the new window, and the diff does not touch the golden file.
Registry-wide coverage invariant test exists in tests/test_coverage.py and is part of the default suite that gate US-413-C6 ran to exit 0, so it still passes with required_bars raised to 200.
Deterministic gate 'uv run pytest -q --no-header' exited 0, matching the story's declared cmd criterion verbatim.

note: All six criteria are satisfied by real, assertion-bearing tests in tests/test_obv_window.py plus the passing offline suite; the registry note is read from the parsed model rather than hardcoded, formula and window are tested separately, and the diff is scoped exactly to the declared files with no padding.
